notes:
- See Codex and Claude Code session and weekly usage on the menu bar when account usage data is available. Individual agent items show the remaining percentage and reset time without opening a flyout.
- Add an All Agents menu bar item and an AI Usage Control Center tile. The combined view shows only agents with available usage data.
- Add or remove menu bar items from a new right-click picker that shows how each item looks on the bar. The Items page in Settings uses the same picker and includes saved shortcuts.
- Drag items directly on the menu bar to rearrange them. Added items now reflow and animate into place instead of overlapping or clipping other items.
- Open Aloft Settings from the menu bar's right-click menu. Battery and Sound previews in Settings now use live values.
- Fix flyouts that could remain invisible or stuck while opening, and remove the empty space below the menu bar item picker.

releases.notes:
- See Codex and Claude Code session and weekly usage on the menu bar when account usage data is available. Individual agent items show the remaining percentage and reset time without opening a flyout.
- Add an All Agents menu bar item and an AI Usage Control Center tile. The combined view shows only agents with available usage data.
- Add or remove menu bar items from a new right-click picker that shows how each item looks on the bar. The Items page in Settings uses the same picker and includes saved shortcuts.
- Drag items directly on the menu bar to rearrange them. Added items now reflow and animate into place instead of overlapping or clipping other items.
- Open Aloft Settings from the menu bar's right-click menu. Battery and Sound previews in Settings now use live values.
- Fix flyouts that could remain invisible or stuck while opening, and remove the empty space below the menu bar item picker.

- Arrange menu bar items on the left, center, or right, and add spacers where needed.
- Place saved website and app shortcuts on the menu bar as well as in Control Center.
- Reorder items in Settings with smoother dragging. Newly added bar shortcuts appear before the existing status items.
- Fix the Items settings page scrolling beyond the window.
- Remove hotkey shortcuts and their recorder after they interfered with normal keyboard input. Previously saved hotkey items are removed from the bar and Control Center when the configuration loads.

- Show a blue indicator when an Aloft update is available.
- Add an Update Aloft option to the app menu.

- Give the menu bar and Control Center a more consistent set of icons, including clearer Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, battery, and volume states.
- Show Do Not Disturb, microphone mute, and Keep Awake status on the bar when active.
- Align the spacing of status icons with clickable bar items.
- Show the current output device and volume or mute status in the sound tooltip.
- Simplify the date and clock flyouts and remove the clock's trailing divider.
- Use matching tooltips throughout Aloft.

- Fix updates closing Aloft before Windows starts the installer.
- Keep the app running and allow retry if the installer cannot launch.
- Prevent automatic installation from development builds and uninstalled executable copies, with clear guidance in Settings.
- Preserve signed download verification, download progress, and automatic relaunch after installation.

Versions 0.1.0 and 0.1.1 may require a manual installation of this release because their updater exits too early. Download and run the Windows installer, then open the installed Aloft app.

- Fix End Task confirmations remaining hidden and blocking other flyouts.
- Show app window action failures instead of silently discarding them.
- Add a working Windows Do Not Disturb toggle with availability detection.
- Remove the Keyboard Brightness widget.
- Include the curated Control Center layout and promotional link launchers on first run, while preserving existing configurations on update.
- Add Portfolio, X, Bluesky, Threads, and GitHub Releases links with cached favicons to About.

- Initial Aloft Windows release.
- Menu bar, Control Center editor, launcher shortcuts, and app settings.
- Signed app updates with version-specific release notes.
